newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian GIB rally grinds to a halt.
newsitem.headline: Belgian GIB rally grinds to a halt.

text.p: Belgian retailer GIB slipped on the Brussels stock market on Monday in a technical reaction after its recent surge, dealers said
GIB ended the day down 2.6 percent at 1,700 after earlier sliding to 1,685 francs, down 3.4 percent. It was quoted at 1,545 francs one month ago.
Dealers said GIB had been benefitting in recent weeks from talk that its search for a partner for some of its businesses, particulary its DIY outlets, might come to fruition.
Investor interest was also fanned by a rumour that French Paribas might consider taking full control of its Belgian Cobepa subsidiary.
"This automatically put the spotlight on GIB," he said.
Cobepa is currently the largest shareholder in GIB with 17.8 percent.
Another trader said there had also been speculation that Cobepa could wish to get out of GIB.
